Transformation/Power-Up

Drawing out the powers of your Namekian fusion has created a Super Namekian!

  • +1 Power Bonus per Namekian you Fuse with to a maximum equal to your Proficiency Bonus
  • Increase all Movement Speed by 5 ft. per Namekian you Fuse with to a maximum equal to your Proficiency Bonus
  • 4 Stamina Upkeep
    • This can be used as a Power-Up for 8 Stamina Upkeep.

Obtained after merging with at least 1 other Namekian
